name: Triple Threat
idea: When you catch the ball, get low and face the hoop. Now you can shoot, pass or dribble.
why: From the triple threat, your defender can't tell what you'll do next. If they stay back, you shoot. If they run up close, you drive past. If a helper comes, you pass to the teammate they left.
tryit: Catch, bend your knees, and hold the ball by your hip with your eyes on the hoop. Have a partner stand far away (shoot), then close (drive), and call out what you'd do.

frames.say: {1} has the ball at the top. {2} and {3} are on the wings.
*Triple threat:* {2} gets low, holds the ball by the hip and looks at the hoop. Now {2} can *shoot*, *pass* or *dribble*.
{X2} runs up close with hands high. Too close to shoot? Then go right past!
*Dribble:* {2} drives past {X2} toward the hoop. Uh oh, {X3} leaves {3} to stop the drive.
*Pass:* {X3} left {3} all alone, so {2} passes to {3}.
{3} shoots! From the triple threat, you're ready to shoot, pass or dribble.
